title: Bounds for an in-window configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a type, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes on input $x$. Suppose every work-tape head is at distance at most $s$ from the origin, and every cell at distance greater than $s$ from the origin is blank. Then each work-tape head is at distance at most $s$ from the origin, and every nonblank cell on every work tape is at distance at most $s$ from the origin.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes

Every work-tape head position has absolute value at most $s$
Every cell whose position has absolute value greater than $s$ contains no symbol
